cover.caption: Askeladden går inn i skogen, og han er ikke det minste redd for troll.
cover.alt: Askeladden går langs en sti i den tåkete høstskogen med øks og skinnsekk. Bak ham, mellom grantrærne, kikker et digert troll fram.
cover.prompt: Askeladden strides along a narrow path through a misty autumn forest with an axe over his shoulder and his leather knapsack on his back, whistling, not a bit afraid. Behind him, half-hidden among the tall spruces and rust-red birches, the enormous Troll leans out from between the trunks and peers down at him with curious yellow eyes. Orange leaves drift through the grey mist.

Picture: Askeladden strides along a narrow path through a misty autumn forest with an axe over his shoulder and his leather knapsack on his back, whistling, not a bit afraid. Behind him, half-hidden among the tall spruces and rust-red birches, the enormous Troll leans out from between the trunks and peers down at him with curious yellow eyes. Orange leaves drift through the grey mist.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- Askeladden: A small, wiry lad of about fourteen, shorter than most boys his age, with a round face, rosy cheeks, bright brown eyes, a button nose, a dark-brown curly mop of hair and a cheeky gap-toothed grin. He wears a moss-green knitted jumper with brown leather elbow patches, dark-brown knee breeches, thick oatmeal-coloured wool stockings and scuffed brown boots, and carries a small, worn brown leather knapsack over one shoulder.
- the Troll: A giant forest troll three times as tall as a man, with cracked, bark-brown skin like an old pine trunk, a shaggy black haystack of hair full of twigs and dry leaves, a potato nose, small twinkly yellow eyes, an enormous mouth that stretches from ear to ear with big square teeth, long dangling arms and a huge, round belly. He wears baggy, patched sackcloth trousers held up by braces of twisted roots, and no shirt.

Story world: Old rural Norway, long ago. A poor old farmer lives with his three sons on a small farm with a low log cottage and a turf roof at the edge of a big forest of spruce and birch. Deep in the forest stands an old spruce with a long grey beard of lichen, and above it rises a steep, rocky mountain where the troll lives behind a heavy wooden door. Inside, everything is troll-sized: two iron buckets as big as barrels, a huge black iron pot over the fire, a long, rough plank table with a bench, giant wooden bowls and spoons as big as spades. Askeladden's cheese is small, round, soft and white, and fits in his hand. His knapsack is a small, worn brown leather knapsack. The brothers' axes are ordinary wood axes with short handles.

This story's season, light and colours: Misty autumn in a deep spruce forest: rust-red and orange birch leaves, golden ferns, dark spruces hung with grey lichen and cool grey mist drifting between the trunks in soft, pale daylight. Inside the mountain: warm amber firelight on rough brown rock. At the end, a cold, clear dawn over the valley.

Art style: Classic Norwegian folk-tale book illustration: fine pen-and-ink line work with transparent watercolour washes on warm, slightly textured off-white paper, in the tradition of 19th-century Scandinavian book illustration, like the plates of an old printed book of folk tales, with a deep red that comes back as the accent. characters.name: Den eldste broren
characters.description: Askeladdens eldste bror, stor og sterk, som kaster fra seg øksa og løper hjem så fort trollet viser seg.
characters.look: A hulking, broad-shouldered young man of about twenty with a thick neck, a broad, flat face, a crooked nose, small pale-blue eyes, heavy black eyebrows and short, bristly black hair cropped close to his head. He wears a shaggy, sleeveless sheepskin vest over a rough grey homespun shirt, baggy brown trousers tied under the knees with leather laces and heavy black boots.

illustrations.caption: Så kastet han øksa fra seg i mosen og la på sprang.
illustrations.alt: Ved en gammel gran med langt lavskjegg står et digert troll og glor. Den eldste broren har kastet fra seg øksa og løper for livet.
